title: Tempo docs: Fees
notes: No native token; fees in USD TIP-20 stablecoins via Fee AMM; bounded dynamic base fee (T7); 50,000-gas transfer cap about 0.0006 USD, quiet floor about 0.00003 USD; fees accrue to the proposing validator.

title: Tempo docs: Connection details
notes: Mainnet chain ID 4217 (rpc.tempo.xyz); Moderato testnet chain ID 42431 (rpc.moderato.tempo.xyz).

title: Tempo docs: Consensus and finality (Simplex BFT)
notes: Simplex BFT by Commonware; blocks about every 600 ms (500 ms builder loop plus latency); deterministic finality; permissioned validator set.

title: Tempo docs: TIP-20 specification and overview
notes: decimals() always returns 6; 32-byte transfer memos; TIP-403 policy registry; T6 receive policies redirect blocked transfers to ReceivePolicyGuard. Overview at https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/protocol/tip20.
